purpose: Training only; excluded from held-out evaluation.
selection_rule: Highest mean clearing averaged over training seeds 101 and 102 among snapshot-capacity powers 2, 4, 8; no held-out cases inspected.
configuration_names: p = capacity_power; h = max_hops (10000 means nodes); c = close_first; snap = snapshot_capacity. Initial grid had snapshot_capacity=False.
audit: Every run independently replayed via simulate.audit and compared against drained graph_snapshot. Training used horizon search_horizon+4000.
implementation_note: Initial runs used algebraically equivalent direct exponential-race scores rather than final log-space scores. Subsequent changes added capacity-payload accounting, input validation and trimming hints during finish, without changing search behavior. Selected seed101 final-source reproduction is checked separately.
